Title: Sensitive-Field Masking and Audit UAT
Description: Human review of mask rendering, audit trail, and Compliance Review viewer.

Reviews.Title: SSN renders masked when no mask exemption exists

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgUserAdmin.
Navigate directly to the customer detail page for the first customer (URL: /customers/{id}, where id is the first customer by DB ID — the one seeded with SocialSecurityNumber "123-45-6789").
Locate the SSN field wrapper on the customer detail page.
Verifications: The SSN field wrapper element (data-testid="field-ssn-wrapper") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Inspect the masked SSN span within the field wrapper.
Verifications: The masked span (data-testid="restricted-field-masked-Customer-SocialSecurityNumber") is visible.
The masked span contains the text "XXX-XX-6789".

Reviews.Title: CrossOrgUserAdmin grants a mask exemption for the Customer role on Customer.SocialSecurityNumber

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgUserAdmin.
Navigate to the Security Dashboard via the Admin drawer group (Admin > Security Dashboard).
Click the "Role Master Details" tab.
Verifications: The role master grid (data-testid="role-master-grid") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Click the row for the "Customer" role in the role master grid.
Verifications: The role row (data-testid="role-row-Customer") is visible.
The role details section (data-testid="role-details-section") is visible after clicking.

Steps.HumanAction: Click the "Mask Exemptions" sub-tab in the role details section.
Verifications: The mask exemptions sub-tab container (data-testid="mask-exemptions-subtab") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Select "Customer" in the Table dropdown labeled "Table".
Select "SocialSecurityNumber" in the Column dropdown labeled "Column".
Click the "Add" button (data-testid="mask-exemption-add-button").
Verifications: The Add button is enabled before clicking.

Steps.HumanAction: Observe the exemption status badge after the add operation completes.
Verifications: The active-status badge (data-testid="mask-exemption-status-active-Customer-SocialSecurityNumber") is visible.

Reviews.Title: Customer with active exemption sees SSN unmasked as clear text

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as customer@acmecoffee.com with role Customer.
Navigate directly to the customer detail page for the first customer (customer@acmecoffee.com is bridged to that customer's organization, so the row-restriction allows access).
Locate the SSN field wrapper on the customer detail page.
Verifications: The SSN field wrapper element (data-testid="field-ssn-wrapper") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Inspect the unmasked SSN text field within the field wrapper.
Verifications: The unmasked text field (data-testid="field-ssn") is visible.
The unmasked text field has the value "123-45-6789".

Reviews.Title: CrossOrgMonitor sees ExemptionGranted and FieldUnmaskedRead events in Compliance Review

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgMonitor.
Navigate to the Security Dashboard via the Admin drawer group (Admin > Security Dashboard).
Click the "Compliance Review" tab.
Observe the Compliance Review tab container.
Verifications: The compliance-review-tab container (data-testid="compliance-review-tab") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Observe the grid scroll region within the Compliance Review tab.
Verifications: The grid scroll region (data-testid="compliance-review-grid-scroll-region") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Type "Customer" in the Entity filter field (labeled "Entity") to scope results.
Scan the grid rows for an ExemptionGranted event chip.
Verifications: At least one event chip (data-testid contains "event-chip") with text "ExemptionGranted" is visible in the grid.

Steps.HumanAction: Scan the grid rows for a FieldUnmaskedRead event chip.
Verifications: At least one event chip (data-testid contains "event-chip") with text "FieldUnmaskedRead" is visible in the grid.

Reviews.Title: Row expander renders the correlation cluster section

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgMonitor.
Navigate to /admin/security and click the "Compliance Review" tab.
Verifications: The compliance-review-tab container (data-testid="compliance-review-tab") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Wait for the grid to populate with audit event rows.
Verifications: At least one event chip (data-testid contains "event-chip") is visible in the grid.

Steps.HumanAction: Click the expand icon button on the first data row in the grid.
Verifications: The expand icon button on the first data row is visible before clicking.

Steps.HumanAction: Observe the expanded row content that appears below the first data row.
Verifications: The expander container (data-testid matching "compliance-review-row-*-expander") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Inspect the correlation cluster content inside the expander container.
Verifications: Either a cluster table (data-testid contains "-cluster-table") is present, or a "No other rows" caption (data-testid contains "-cluster-empty") is present. At least one of the two must render.

Reviews.JudgmentJustification: Whether the correlation cluster contains sibling rows depends on the Blazor circuit scope at audit-emission time. RoleSwitch and FieldUnmaskedRead share a CorrelationId only when they occur on the same page without an intervening navigation (the RenderCorrelationScope resets on LocationChanged). In the standard UAT flow they occur on separate pages, so the cluster may show "No other rows." The reviewer must judge that the cluster UI renders correctly regardless of sibling count.

Reviews.Title: Export CSV button triggers a download and shows a success snackbar

Steps.HumanAction: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role CrossOrgMonitor.
Navigate to /admin/security and click the "Compliance Review" tab.
Verifications: The compliance-review-tab container (data-testid="compliance-review-tab") is visible.

Steps.HumanAction: Locate the Export CSV button on the Compliance Review tab.
Verifications: The Export CSV button (data-testid="compliance-review-export-button") is enabled.

Steps.HumanAction: Click the Export CSV button.
Observe the snackbar notification area after the export operation completes.
Verifications: A success snackbar containing the text "Exported" appears.

summary: The JSON is mostly well-structured and covers the six required reviews, but it is not fully faithful to the Playwright source of truth. At least one explicit assertion is missing, and several HumanAction entries do not match the test step wording as required.

issues.title: UAT-4 omits the Entity filter visibility assertion
issues.details: In UAT-4 Step 6, the Playwright test explicitly verifies that the Entity filter field is visible before filling it (`Expect(entityFilter).ToBeVisibleAsync(...)`). The checklist step only says to type "Customer" in the field and provides no verification. The correct checklist should include a verification such as: "The Entity filter field (label \"Entity\") is visible."

issues.title: Multiple HumanAction entries are paraphrased instead of matching the source steps verbatim
issues.details: The task required HumanAction text to match the test navigation/click actions verbatim. Several steps were rewritten with different verbs like "Locate," "Inspect," and "Observe" instead of preserving the Playwright step wording such as "Verify... is visible." Examples include UAT-1 Steps 3-4, UAT-3 Steps 3-4, UAT-4 Steps 4-5, UAT-5 Steps 5-6, and UAT-6 Step 5. These should be rewritten to mirror the source step text so the checklist maintains mechanical parity with the tests.
